findings.detail: The issuer_name field absorbs section labels and the adjacent Type, Reference Rate, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date columns instead of retaining only the issuer.

rationale: The filing schedule presents issuer, type, reference rate, interest rate, and maturity as separate columns. At table 28 row 26 the issuer cell is Benefit Street Partners Clo Vi-B Ltd, while the flagged issuer_name concatenates category text and all adjacent terms through the maturity date. Table 43 row 7 independently shows the same column structure for Behavioral Framework LLC. The C206 flag therefore identifies a real, localized issuer-name extraction defect rather than valid issuer text. No aggregate anchor is applicable.
